tab: Where in the workspace is it worst?

story.label: Every run
story.caption: The fourth tab over all 18,507 runs: every joint's position × speed plane on the bench's own coverage cells, coloured by the tracking error made in each cell, one colour scale. The answer names the worst cell; the list beside it holds the targets through it.

story.label: One pick: ctc_tuned
story.caption: One rail pick, Config = ctc_tuned: the six UR5e joints are left, and the worst cell moves to the wrist in the collision dataset.

story.label: Another cell
story.caption: A click on a cell (here the worst cell of another joint) lists the targets through it, worst first; the cell is outlined.

story.label: A target through it
story.caption: A row of the list opens the stock drill pane with Open target view.

story.label: Its target view
story.caption: Open target view: keep= the runs of that target the rail keeps (ctc_tuned's), back= this tab with the filter.
